column1: # What a long Treasury DID across the equity declines since 1962, on the model bond's footing, as a
# REPORTED reference beside the graded TLT-era targets (crash-response-2026-09-25.tsv): for every
# CRSP value-weighted market decline of 15% or worse from 1962-01-03 to 2026-06-30, the bond's LOG
# return over the same peak-to-trough span, in percent, and its empirical duration over that span.
# Each episode is read as bondPct x 13.5 / duration, and the regime medians are +9.1 growth (10
# episodes) and -6.3 inflation (7); `BondLongRecordSuite` / `bond_crash_tests` re-derive both from
# the rows below and the report prints them under the graded rows.  NOT GRADED: the graded targets
# stay the TLT era's (+7.0 / -27.9), where the bond is the fund a consumer holds and the 2022 shock
# is the inflation regime the model's own `inflPress` names.
# Sources, published: the market is Ken French's F-F_Research_Data_Factors_daily (Mkt-RF + RF
# compounded); the bond is a 20-year par Treasury rebought daily from FRED's DGS20 constant-maturity
# yield (the coupon accrues over the calendar days held, the price moves with the yield, semiannual
# compounding; `record_bands -yahoo DGS20.csv` reads the same series), its 1987-1993 gap filled with
# DGS30's daily changes on DGS20's last level; CPI is FRED's CPIAUCSL.  Against TLT over 2002-2026
# the bond's weekly log returns correlate 0.975 and the six TLT-era episodes read within 1-2 points.
# duration: minus the slope of the bond's weekly (5-session) log return on the weekly change of the
#   20-year yield over peak..trough; the par bond's modified duration at the peak's yield where the
#   span holds fewer than four weeks (1980).
# cpiPeak / cpiTrough: CPI year over year at the peak and the trough, percent.
# regime: inflation when CPI year over year ROSE over the decline and stood at 4% or more at the
#   trough, else growth.  The rule is the record side's stand-in for the model's `inflPress`
#   regime; under it 1981-82 (CPI 10.8 -> 6.0) is a growth episode, the disinflation rally of +37.5
#   scaled.  The 1960s-80s inflation episodes cost the bond 3-16 points, 2022 alone 29, so an
#   inflation median over seven episodes is a fifth of the TLT era's one.
